chunks: And he drew forth his hand, and lo, it looked white to the beholders.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the white hand miracle in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this sign (ayah) is often interpreted not merely as a physical miracle but as a manifestation of divine light (nur) that purifies the observer's heart, prefiguring the spiritual illumination of the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a tangible confirmation of Musa’s truthfulness before Pharaoh’s court, emphasizing the clarity of divine guidance against the obscurity of tyranny.
